claims.where: page tile tW + time series (head)
claims.claim: Head change under a policy in N2's unit (headline, tile tW, start note)
claims.wording_en: Head change, policy minus baseline, in this model: the mean over N2's 84 Yunlin monitoring wells, each in its own screened layer (N2's scoring unit; built into the page as an aggregate, payload n2Unit). Tile range line: 'direction supported (design-time, R0 recipe); within-window anomaly response decided by N2 not before 2028-01-15; level report-only'. Direction supported by the registered masked 2016-18 refit in Yunlin (step C, N1P.C_heads_yunlin), scored on the R0 recipe (stage3_datum_gate_cwa) on a design-time window and carried to the page model only by a post-hoc, model-only comparison (science-05 transfer file); the 2015 drought spring (G1) agrees but mixes canal water and rain with pumping. Size likely too small (slopes reported, not gated; no calibrated correction factor follows). N2 decides the within-window response to recorded Yunlin pumping anomalies: 'response supported' needs the 90 % interval of the per-well-demeaned anomaly slope to exclude 0, the slope inside [1/1.5, 1.5] and RMSE(PR) < RMSE(ZR); a 'not supported' result cannot separate the model from its X1 forcing; the level is report-only; scored no earlier than 2028-01-15. Carrying it to a class lever is a linear, model-only transfer. The tile's definition adds the model-only start-state check (FS.start_invariance.v1, row E23): 'does not depend on the 2022-12 start state (within 5 %, model-only declaration FS.start_invariance.v1)', with the measured largest departure.
claims.notes: Model output, recomputed in the page build from the forward run (cut30 / retire_aqua at Dec 2032): N2 unit +1.19 / +1.41 m (84 of 84 registered Yunlin wells found; station ids from the registered prospective predictions.csv, county code 09; cells and layers from the calibration wells, the same mapping as twin.coverage). Layer-2 context kept in the tile's detail line: named-Yunlin-township cell mean +1.37 m, fan average +0.90 m (about 20 % Changhua spillover). The S part rests on R0 tests only; G1 is consistent context, not the pumping-response test. The page carries no station id, cell or layer: n2Unit holds only the per-year means. Rank 7 result: FS.start_invariance.v1 (registered 2026-11-01, sha 9f8a7115; scored once, report results/dataprep/reports/FS.start_invariance.v1/report.json sha 6130a3bf): verdict pass, wording case 'pass'. Largest |R - 1| over the 20 gated cells 9.74e-06 % (S1 free-run start 3.42e-06 %, S2 old untapered field restart 9.74e-06 %); largest per-well p90 deviation 9.07e-07; no failing arm. The invariance holds to numerical precision, as expected because the head solver is linear in the start state; this is a different property from FV.decidability.v1's failed pumping superposition (0.28 m), which concerned nonlinearity in the pumping multipliers. The start moves the levels only early (N2-unit baseline shift, arm minus S0: Jan 2023 -0.23 m for S1 and +0.77 m for S2; Dec 2026 about 1e-06 m; Dec 2032 0), not the policy differences. C01 gains, on the tile tW definition, 'In this model the head change does not depend on the 2022-12 start state (within 5 %, model-only declaration FS.start_invariance.v1): largest departure < 0.001 %.' (fs_pass, row E23), and the start note adds start_note_fs when it is shown. No status moves (C01 stays S+D); the start itself is decided only by the prospective tests (E02, N2).
